title: Treatment of rheumatoid arthritis with curcumin analog 3,5-bis(arylidene)-4-piperidone.
authors: Li, Wenxuan; Yan, Weibin; Liu, Yongjun; Hou, Guige; Li, Chengbo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素类似物6d通过抑制NF-kappaB治疗类风湿关节炎，虽含分子对接但仅涉及小分子-蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is an inflammatory disease. Curcumin can inhibit NF-kappaB and reduce the expression of inflammation-related genes. Aim: To evaluate the potential development of 6d in the clinical treatment of inflammatory diseases such as RA. Methods: Using a skeleton fusion strategy to synthesize curcumin analogues for 6d. This work evaluates anti-inflammatory activity by conducting anti-arthritis experiments (adjuvant-induced RA models) on rats. Western blot and ELISA were used to detect the expression of inflammatory-related proteins and cytokines. Molecular docking analysis confirmed the binding effect of 6d with active sites. Conclusion: 6d inhibits NF-kappaB has a protective effect on arthritis caused by RA.
abstract_zh: 类风湿性关节炎（RA）是一种炎症性疾病。姜黄素能够抑制NF-kappaB并减少炎症相关基因的表达。目的：评估6d在RA等炎症性疾病临床治疗中的潜在发展。方法：采用骨架融合策略合成姜黄素类似物6d。本研究通过在大鼠上进行抗关节炎实验（佐剂诱导的RA模型）来评估抗炎活性。使用Western blot和ELISA检测炎症相关蛋白和细胞因子的表达。分子对接分析确认了6d与活性位点的结合效应。结论：6d抑制NF-kappaB，对RA引起的关节炎具有保护作用。
